facts.text: NuvuCamUtils inherits nc_camera
The NuvuCamUtils constructor opens the camera with openCam(nbBuff=4)
NC_api selects libnuvu.so for ELF, nc_driver_x64.dll for 64-bit WindowsPE and nc_driver_Win32.dll for 32-bit WindowsPE using platform.architecture()
camStart(nbrImg) starts acquisition of nbrImg images, and nbrImg 0 is continuous acquisition
camAbort stops all image acquisition on the camera
camIsAcquring queries the SDK with ncCamIsAcquiring and returns 1 while acquiring and 0 otherwise, despite a docstring copied from camStart
NuvuCamUtils.cam_stop calls camAbort and clears the wrapper's isrunning flag
get_image uses disconnect_if_error_real, flushes the read queue and returns getImg()
getImg reads an image and copies its uint16 pointer with shape (width, height)
The exposure time is set in milliseconds
The readout mode is documented as 0=nothing, 1=EM, 2=CONV
The trigger mode is documented as -3=CONT_HIGH_LOW, -2=EXT_HIGH_LOW_EXP, -1=EXT_HIGH_LOW, 0=INTERNAL, 1=EXT_LOW_HIGH, 2=EXT_LOW_HIGH_EXP, 3=CONT_LOW_HIGH
The shutter mode is documented as 0=NOT SET, 1=open, 2=closed, 3=auto
The target detector temperature range is queried from the camera at run time with getTargetDetectorTempRange
The calibrated EM gain range is queried from the camera at run time with getCalibratedEmGainRange
getAllCamInfo queries the camera and returns the widths, exposure, temperatures, shutter mode, calibrated EM gain, raw gain, target detector temperature and trigger mode in one dictionary
The repository's BLACS worker reads the detector temperature, raw and calibrated EM gain, exposure time and readout mode from getAllCamInfo
The BLACS worker's configure_acquisition calls cam_stop before cam_start
errorHandling closes the camera with noRaise=True and raises NuvuException for errors other than 27; error 27 raises without closing
The disconnect_if_error_real decorator closes the camera and re-raises on an exception
The upstream example acquires one image with cam_start(1), get_image(), cam_stop() and cam_close()
The README states that the repository implemented Nuvu Camera python drivers
